text:
anna-oncall: Paging — seeing inconsistent KV/prefix cache reads causing incorrect completions for a small set of tenants. Started ~2026-11-04T09:12:00Z after rollout of aggressive prefix caching (cfg-2026-09). Affected: tenant-alpha, tenant-bk, tenant-gamma. Immediate customer-facing errors: garbled/missing tokens and occasional 500s when cache returns invalid payloads.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-451 created, severity: high. Paging oncall.

sanjay: I can reproduce locally with the sample trace id=trace-0a1b2c — cache returns payload where 'length' field != token array length. Looks like an off-by-one from the new serialization path.

maya-sre: Confirmed elevated 5xx from model-proxy when trying to parse cached KV entries. Error rate up ~6% for affected tenants, overall system 0.6%.

eli-plat: Quick mitigation plan:
- quarantine: disable prefix cache for affected tenants
- apply soft rate limit on prefix lookup route (prefix.lookup) to 10rps per tenant
- rollback cfg-2026-09 if quarantine doesn't stabilize

sanjay: I can flip the tenant-level flag. Command below (will scope to tenant-* buckets):
```
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/feature-flags" \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"flag":"prefix_cache_enabled","scope":{"tenants":["tenant-alpha","tenant-bk","tenant-gamma"]},"value":false}'
```

anna-oncall: Executing now — will post updates. I'm pausing automated prefix cache warmers.

(1m later)

anna-oncall: Done. prefix_cache_enabled=false for listed tenants. Observability: error rate for those tenants dropping from 6% -> 1.2% within 30s.

eli-plat: Adding a traffic-shaping rule at edge to rate-limit prefix.lookup and to rewrite any lookups for keys matching `^user:.*` to bypass cache entirely. Rule posted.

maya-sre: Pushed edge rule; verifying RPS. For tenant-alpha we set quota to 30rps temporarily to avoid thundering herd while cache is off.

cs-rep: Notifying CS/affected customers: Alpha and BK have been notified via email + support tickets. No data loss; correctness issues only while cache served bad payloads.

sanjay: Root cause trace so far: recent serialization optimization used nullable headers and a new packing format; deserializer on runtime doesn't handle missing header in a specific codepath leading to truncated token arrays. Plan: revert packing change and add strict validation.

eli-plat: Escalating to runtime team. @maya-sre you'll stay on for monitoring. I'm taking the incident lead and will be oncall until 15:00 UTC. Handing next steps to runtime squad.

maya-sre: Oncall acked, will monitor dashboards and page if regression.

ops-bot: Handoff note added to INC-2026-451: \"eli-plat leading mitigation; maya-sre monitoring; runtime team engaged (sanjay)\".

anna-oncall: Customer impact summary for now: 3 tenants with correctness issues; degraded UX but temporary. Mitigations: tenant-level prefix cache disabled, prefix.lookup rate-limited, temporary quotas applied, edge rewrite to bypass cache. Immediate risk reduced to negligible. Follow-up: postmortem, test coverage for serialization, and a canary rollout strategy for config changes.

sanjay: I'll open a PR to revert packing change and include a unit test for token count parity. ETA for PR: 3 hours. Will schedule a canary deploy after tests.

eli-plat: Thanks all. I'll keep the ticket open and update when runtime rollforward happens. If anyone adds findings, paste them here.

anna-oncall: Closing slack thread for now; incident remains open in tracker. :white_check_mark:
